test_index_constructor_inference: test the Index constructor infers correct dtype from object arrays of bools, complex numbers, and NaT values
test_index_nat_inference: test the Index constructor infers datetime64 dtype when given all NaT, None, or nan values
test_index_dtype_enforcement: test the Index constructor respects the dtype parameter and does not silently ignore it
test_index_constructor_mixed_types: test the Index constructor handles mixed datetime/timedelta, datetime with different timezones, and object arrays
test_index_constructor_from_series: test the Index constructor unwraps Series and array-like objects correctly to produce the expected Index type
